scheme_name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Sustenance Allowance
other_conditions: Individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution
Open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc.
Startups already receiving benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible
benefits_summary: Provides ₹20,000 per month for one year, with an enhanced ₹25,000 per month for startups having a woman co‑founder.
